postingDescription:
Role Summary
The Senior ServiceNow Developer will configure, customize, and develop ServiceNow ITBM/SPM capabilities supporting application cost transparency, cost allocations, showback reporting, data integrations, dashboards, automation, and governance controls.
Key Responsibilities
Platform Development
•	Configure and customize: 
o	ServiceNow Financial Management
o	APM
o	ITBM/SPM modules
o	PL/SQL module
o	Cost allocation structures
•	Develop application-centric cost reporting capabilities.
rolesResponsibilities:
Dashboard & Reporting Development
•	Build dashboards enabling: 
o	Application cost overview
o	CI-based cost reporting
o	Location-based reporting
o	Environment-based reporting
o	Monthly and yearly cost reporting
o	Trend analysis
•	Develop interactive filters for: 
o	Applications
o	Locations
o	Lifecycle Status
o	Environments
o	Service Types
Integration Development
•	Develop integrations with: 
o	CMDB
o	Asset Management systems
o	ERP systems
o	Monitoring platforms
o	Cloud financial management platforms
•	Develop API-based export services.
Cost Allocation Automation
•	Implement: 
o	Cost driver calculations
o	Shared service allocations
o	Consumption-based costing
o	Monthly allocation jobs
o	Financial reconciliation workflows
Data Quality & Governance Automation
•	Develop: 
o	Data quality scorecards
o	CMDB validation routines
o	Automated exception handling
o	Cost reporting quality checks
o	Operational monitoring dashboards
Performance Reporting
•	Integrate Event Management and monitoring tools.
•	Develop automated performance reporting and KPI dashboards.
•	Support monitoring data ingestion and reporting automation.
Operational Support
•	Support deployment and production releases.
•	Troubleshoot platform issues.
•	Optimize performance and reporting queries.
•	Create technical documentation and runbooks.
